resume_text:
NIHALA SHIRIN VALAPRA
FULL STACK DEVELOPER
+91 9074649659 nihalashirin02@gmail.com Linkedln Leetcode GitHub
PROFILE SUMMARY
Passionate and self-taught Full-Stack Developer with strong expertise in Python and Django, complemented by
hands-on experience in JavaScript, python, Node.js, Django, Express, Next.js, React.js, and RESTful APIs. Skilled in
building scalable, high-quality applications by leveraging both back-end and front-end technologies. Committed to
continuous learning and staying updated with emerging trends to deliver robust, efficient software solutions. Strong
problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset ensure effective contribution to dynamic development teams.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript
Back-End Development: Django, Django REST Framework, Node.js, ORM (Django ORM, SQLAlchemy), RESTful
APIs, Clean Architecture, MVC Architecture, MVT Architecture, Express.js, Postman
Front-End Development: Next.js, React.js, Redux, Redux Toolkit (RTK), TanStack Query (React Query), Tailwind
CSS, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
Integrations: Git, GitHub, Razorpay, JWT, Figma, Nginx, Gunicorn, AWS , Firebase, Vercel,Render,S3 Bucket,
Gemini API,
Expertise In: Data Structures & Algorithms
MAIN PROJECTS
Vector- E-Learning Platform
Live Link GitHub
Built a scalable full-stack learning and gaming platform using a monorepo architecture with Next.js for the user-
facing application, React.js for the admin panel, and Django for the backend API. The platform supports role-based
access for users, staff, and admins, includes course management, live video classes, interactive game-based learning,
and Stripe payment integration for secure transactions. Implemented cloud-based image storage, designed a modern
and responsive interface using ShadCN UI, and automated deployment using CI/CD pipelines. The application is
deployed with the frontend on Vercel and the backend on Render, ensuring high availability and performance.
Tech Stack: Next.js, React.js (Admin Panel), Django, PostgreSQL, Monorepo, ShadCN UI, Stripe, WebRTC, CI/CD,
Cloud Storage (AWS/Cloudinary), Vercel, Render
Caremall-E-commerce website
Live Link
Developed Caremall, a full-featured e-commerce platform with user, admin, warehouse, ERP, and affiliate marketing
modules, built using a monorepo architecture.
I primarily worked on the user-facing application, admin panel, and warehouse management module, focusing on
scalable architecture, clean UI, and efficient data handling.
The frontend was built using React.js, Redux, Tailwind CSS, ShadCN UI, and TanStack Query for optimized state and
server data management. The backend was developed with Node.js and Express.js, using MongoDB for flexible and
•
scalable data storage.
Implemented secure online payments using Razorpay, integrated cloud asset storage with AWS S3, and deployed the
frontend on Vercel and the backend on AWS EC2. Set up CI/CD pipelines to enable automated testing and
deployment, ensuring scalability, performance, and smooth operations across products, orders, warehouse, and ERP
workflows.
Tech Stack: React.js, Tailwind CSS, ShadCN UI, Redux, TanStack Query,Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, AWS EC2,
AWS S3, CI/CD Pipelines, Vercel (Frontend), AWS EC2 (Backend),Monorepo
E-Commerce Platform
Linkedin Post GitHub
This is an e-commerce website focused on the sale of fashion products, built to provide users with a smooth and
responsive shopping experience. The platform features a responsive design developed using Bootstrap, ensuring
compatibility across all devices. It includes secure user registration and login with email OTP verification, allowing
users to manage their products, orders, and addresses easily. Products are displayed with detailed views, multiple
images, and categorized listings that include search and sorting
f
options for easy navigation. The backend is powered by Django with PostgreSQL for efficient data handling and
optimized performance. Razorpay is integrated for secure and seamless online payments. The application is deployed
on AWS EC2 and follows the MVT architecture with version control using Git.
Tech Stack
Tech Stack: Python, Django (MVT Architecture),HTML, CSS, Bootstrap,PostgreSQL, Razorpay, AWS EC2, Git
GitHub
QuickBlog
QuickBlog is a full-stack blog application built using Django and MySQL. It includes secure user authentication with
JWT and a RESTful API for managing blog posts. Users can create, edit, and delete blogs, browse by categories, and
interact through likes and comments. The interface is built with Django templates and Tailwind CSS for a modern,
responsive design, while Axios enables smooth dynamic content loading. The admin panel allows easy management
of users, posts, comments, and categories. The application is deployed on AWS EC2 for scalability, security, and
reliable performance.
QuickStay - Hotel Management System Live Link GitHub
Designed and developed a fully responsive hotel management system frontend that allows users to browse
rooms, register, log in, and manage bookings. The application features a clean and intuitive user interface
built with modern UI practices to ensure a seamless experience across all devices. User authentication and
session management were securely handled using Clerk, enabling protected routes and personalized
access. The project focused on delivering high performance and fast load times through efficient
development practices using React and Vite, while Tailwind CSS was used to create a visually
appealing and consistent design throughout the application. The system is optimized for performance and
fast load times and is deployed on Vercel for reliable delivery and scalability
Experience / Internship Section
Full Stack Developer 2025-present
Freelance Developer
Full Stack Developer Trainee 2023 - 2025
Brototype, Calicut
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Physics (B.Sc. Physics) 2020 - 2023
Calicut University
Science 2018 - 2020
GHSS chullikode,Kuzhimanna
job_description:
Job Title: Python Developer

Experience: 2+ Years
Location: Remote / Hybrid / Onsite

📌 Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Python Developer with 2+ years of experience to join our development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building scalable backend systems, developing APIs, optimizing database performance, and contributing to high-quality software solutions.

This role requires strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic environment.

🔹 Key Responsibilities

Develop, test, and maintain applications using Python

Design and implement RESTful APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django

Work with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB)

Optimize application performance and improve scalability

Integrate third-party services and APIs

Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code

Participate in code reviews and follow development best practices

Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues

Collaborate with frontend, DevOps, and QA teams

Document technical processes and solutions

🔹 Required Skills

Strong proficiency in Python

Experience with backend frameworks (FastAPI / Flask / Django)

Solid understanding of REST API design

Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases

Knowledge of Git version control

Basic understanding of Linux environments

Familiarity with asynchronous programming concepts

Good debugging and analytical skills

🔹 Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)

Knowledge of Docker and containerization

Exposure to CI/CD pipelines

Understanding of microservices architecture

Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

🎓 Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
